_comment: Ratchet baseline for scripts/check-tag-hygiene.mjs. Every value is a DEFECT COUNT that must not grow. Re-measured on prod 2026-08-23 after the whole tag DQ program landed (Phases 0-5). Tighten with `node scripts/check-tag-hygiene.mjs --update` after a cleanup; never loosen a number to make CI pass. duplicate_active_name 9 -> 14 on 2026-08-23: the marketplace facet vocabulary (color-*/size-*/genre-*/fit-*) is namespaced BY SLUG precisely so it can coexist with the glossary vocabulary, so a facet tag's display name colliding with a glossary tag's is by design, not a defect. The five new pairs are color-black/black, genre-history/history, genre-romance/romance, color-gold/mat-gold and color-silver/mat-silver — the same shape as the nine already baselined (mat-leather/leather, mat-denim/denim, occ-pride/news-pride ...). The vocabulary is a fixed 54-row seed, so this number is stable, not a trend.

_notes.alias_equals_name: Zero-invariant since 20261012090000 deleted the 47 rows. An alias identical to its own tag's name says nothing; the sitelink importer minted them alongside real aliases.
_notes.refusal_prose_active: Zero-invariant since 20261012090000 nulled the 175 'No information available' stamps and 38 'There is no information available...' LLM refusal essays. Same class as placeholder_description_active but on short_description/long_description, which that counter never reads.
_notes.unreviewed_typed_alias: Review queue depth, advisory by nature. ~65 after the 2026-08-29 alias truth pass approved everything mechanically safe; what remains is deliberately unapproved (ordinary-word street names like Speed/Acid/Ice are true synonyms but catastrophic auto-tagging rules) or awaiting a human. Growth means a producer is minting typed aliases as 'auto' again.
_notes.relations_pending_review: Grows BY DESIGN while tag_relation_verify works through the >=0.85 embedding pairs (~1,700) - each named verdict lands here as review_status='pending' and displays nowhere. Baseline is the 120 legacy 'auto' co-occurrence rows the display gate hid on the same day. Drains only through admin approval.
_notes.prose_unreviewed: Drain gauge for tag-enrichment-sweep mode='prose' (~300/day over the 2,903 prose-bearing tags). New tags refill it, so it is a sawtooth like uncategorized_active; a flat high number means the cron stopped.
_notes.duplicate_active_name: 9 is correct, not a backlog: the deliberate mat-* sense splits (mat-leather vs leather) excluded by 20260916110000. Growth means a real twin pair regrew.
_notes.redirect_to_non_canonical: INERT rows, not live 301-into-404s — retracted 2026-08-23. The edge lookup filters redirect targets on status=active (PR #2828), so /tags/alex-j-rgen returns a clean 404 in one hop rather than redirecting into one; verified on prod. 57 of the 58 are accent-folding pairs (alex-j-rgen -> alex-jurgen, bisexualit-t -> bisexualitat). Kept, not deleted: a deprecated tag can be revived and 20260910181447 re-mints redirects when that happens. Hygiene counter, not exposure.
_notes.indexable_without_description: 869 thin public pages advertised in sitemap-tags.xml. 20260921110000 deindexes them and re-indexes on prose, after which this becomes a real zero-invariant rather than a backlog.
_notes.sensitive_without_description: Grows as the profession pipeline lands is_adult German profession tags with no description yet — not a regression introduced by the tag DQ program.
_notes.uncategorized_active: Advisory from 2026-08-23 because the number is a SAWTOOTH, not a level, and gating on its instantaneous value fails PRs at random. New tags arrive uncategorized continuously from the ingest and profession pipelines; tag-enrichment-sweep drains them by writing unified_tags.category_id (supabase/functions/tag-enrichment-sweep/index.ts:236), capped at cat_limit<=50 per run on the tag_enrichment_sweep cron, which is every TWO hours (0 */2 * * *) — so between sweeps the count climbs and a PR whose CI lands in the wrong half of the cycle reds on a backlog its author never touched. Measured, same commit and same prod: 25 at 19:35Z (which failed docs-only PR #3027) and 14 at 22:45Z, at which point the identical gate passed and #3027 auto-merged. Nine of those 14 were created that day and were waiting for the next sweep. The value is deliberately NOT re-baselined upward — 14 is the drained floor and the right number; what was wrong was treating a queue depth as an invariant. If this ever needs to be a hard gate again, gate on rows uncategorized for longer than one sweep interval (age, not count), which is the quantity that actually means the sweep stopped.
_notes.event_tag_strings_unresolved: Phase 4 scope marker. events does not use the unified tag system at all — 35,131 events carry a free-text tags[] array and unified_tag_assignments has ZERO entity_type='event' rows. 363 of 535 distinct strings resolve to no tag, German-heavy (1920er, ableismus, aidshilfe, austellung/ausstellungen, ballet/ballett). The plan estimated 40 of 80. Tracked, not fixed: reconciling needs Phase 1.3's hand-reviewed disposition at 363x the size.
_notes.merged_but_not_status_merged: TIGHTENED 1 -> 0 on 2026-08-25, measured on prod: 20260926110000 has applied and community-center is resolved (it was the only live tag in its cluster and community-centers is merged INTO it, so it IS the canonical). The other 8 were repaired by 20260921130000. It was baselined at the LIVE 1 on purpose while the migration was pending — CI measures prod, so baselining the post-migration 0 would have failed every PR until it landed. Now a true zero-invariant: non-zero means a merge wrote merged_into_id without flipping status. redirect_to_non_canonical read 57 in the same measurement and was deliberately NOT tightened to it — reviving a deprecated tag re-mints redirects (20260910181447), so that counter legitimately oscillates and ratcheting it to a trough manufactures a red on a normal event. The admin panel's `zero` flag (destructive styling) is pinned to THIS value in both directions by src/lib/__tests__/tagHygienePanelMetrics.test.ts, so baseline and panel cannot drift apart.
_notes._advisory: Metrics in _advisory WARN instead of failing. They drift continuously from writers outside the tag glossary (the profession pipeline lands is_adult tags daily), so gating a PR on them would red unrelated work for a change its author did not make — the same reasoning that keeps check-legal-citation-links off pull_request. The remaining metrics are true zero-or-fixed invariants and stay hard gates.
_notes.events_with_tags_unlinked: Baselined at the LIVE value (all 35,131 events with tags[] are unlinked right now), not the post-migration 0 — CI measures prod, so baselining the target fails every PR until 20260927100000 applies. Advisory while the cron drains it; tighten to 0 with --update once it reaches zero, after which non-zero means the job stopped.
_notes.denorm_category_missing: ADVISORY from 2026-08-29, and baselined at its live value rather than 0, because it is a QUEUE DEPTH and not an invariant. applySuggestion's 'category' branch (supabase/functions/_shared/ai-suggestions.ts) writes the junction row and DELIBERATELY does not touch unified_tags.category_id -- its own comment gives the reason: that write fires sync_tag_category_assignment -> unified_tags_recompute_is_adult, which re-enters the same row. The denorm is left to the tag_category_resync cron (10 3 * * *). So every admin category approval opens a window in which this reads non-zero until the next nightly reconcile, and a hard zero gate fails any PR whose CI lands in that window -- measured flapping 1 -> 0 -> 1 inside two hours on 2026-08-29, reddening unrelated PRs each time. Same reasoning, same conclusion as uncategorized_active above. If it should ever become a hard gate again, gate on AGE (rows unreconciled for longer than one reconcile interval), which is the quantity that actually means the reconciler stopped.
_notes.placeholder_description_active: 137 is a BACKLOG being worked down, not an accepted level. These are tags publishing a bulk-import stamp as their definition — "Sexual activity tag" (63 rows), "Toys tag" (83), "Philia tag" (24), "Scene safety tag" (12), 182 rows corpus-wide across all statuses. Hard gate rather than advisory because no writer outside this program produces them: the four strings come from one historical import, and the live tag producers (source-tags-extract, the profession pipeline) mint tags with NO description, which indexable_without_description already covers. The stamp set is DETECTED in SQL (any description <=40 chars shared by more than five tags), not listed, so a fifth string is caught without a migration. Tighten as each prose batch lands. Why it needed a counter at all: indexable_without_description reads 0 on the same corpus, because a placeholder is not an empty string — and run_tag_thin_page_reindex() cannot deindex these either, for the same reason. /tags/anal-sex, /tags/rimming and /tags/fisting are all indexable and all say "Sexual activity tag".
_notes.active_tags_with_image_url: Zero-invariant since the 2026-08-28 photo retirement: glossary photography was removed wholesale (tags render drawn TagPlates; migration 20261003100000 nulls the image columns and snapshots the old values into tag_image_retirement). Non-zero means a writer is reintroducing photos — the known writers (store-tag-images, tag-enrichment-sweep fillImage, bulk-create-ai-tags, the admin form and the CMS media group) were all removed in the same change. The photo-era counters (image_without_license, commons_image_without_license, image_alt_column_empty) were dropped from SQL + baseline + panel in lockstep on 2026-08-29 once the retirement was live — they measured a corpus that no longer exists. The SQL half of that drop was applied LIVE before its PR merged, for the inverse of the merged_but_not_status_merged deadlock: the gate fails on any prod stats key missing from the baseline.
